**Summary:** MSc Bioinformatics candidate (University of Birmingham Dubai, expected 2026) with a
First Class BSc (Hons) in Biotechnology (University of Northumbria, 2024). Research in
machine-learning detection of crop disease from UAV imagery; laboratory experience in DNA
extraction, PCR and hydroponic cultivation; clinical documentation experience.

A summary of my education, experience and skills is on the [About](about.qmd) page.
